ylabel: Γ* : box stops binding (W takes over)
note: Binding frontier (treated arm). BELOW the line (smaller Γ): the odds-box is tighter, so the BOX binds and the W-ball is slack. ABOVE the line (larger Γ): the box is looser than what the W-ball already implies, so the WASSERSTEIN ball binds. The relation is near-linear, Γ* ≈ 4.3 + 52·ε; at the tight ε (c=1, green line) the box stops binding around Γ*≈7.
